title: stelis platystylis
intro: Stelis platystylis, commonly known as the Purple-styled Stelis, is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. The health benefits of Stelis platystylis include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, which may help to lower blood pressure and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of Stelis platystylis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
